facts.fact: 镰中问答：Valentin 解释——「when one soul stitches itself to another it knew in life. It’s called soul-binding.」——Jas 生魔缝 Risha 死魔=罕见强合——「Certainly powerful enough to deny your body a well-deserved death.」
姑婆先例：séance 出错的曾姑婆——渐失自我、举止失常、需专人看护——「And how do you feel, knowing this could be your future?」
facts.anchor: A caretaker had to be with her at all times

facts.fact: fulcrum 推论：Thana 之本源非物理而是 spiritual——「Could we join the spiritual components together to make the fulcrum whole again?」——「I'd have to join them. And someone promised me a new body.」——Risha 谎报（body+title+Mortri）骗 Valentin 入伙。
facts.anchor: You want to soul-bind the kings together.

facts.fact: Dante 双角后：竖瞳、异常轻快——「I’d happily become a monster.」——Risha 转念：Taesia 的堕落之路原来是这种 desperate sacrifice。
遗属会议：Anatolia（孕）/Klara+Alarik——Ulshära 提议遗孀暂代 imperator 职（「I will make it so」）——Klara 要求讲述 Varrick 之死真相。

Anatolia 私谢：Nevasha（Solari 谢语）——「He is free of Phos now.」——Risha 能看见婴儿的 feeble tether（braided lifelines）——问「how you can find it in yourself to bring more life into an ending world」——答「The world is maybe breaking, but there is good here. I do not need to break with it.」
facts.anchor: He is free of Phos now.

facts.fact: 图纸到手：Dante 自 Aphelion 归——地下密藏 leather folio（Dawn Throne 图纸）——「our inter-planar friend had some sway on the guards」——Oskar 见 Noctan 惊退。
facts.anchor: You were right to suspect that Varrick kept his valuables underground.

facts.fact: Oskar 之诫：「His family played patron to mine. That makes them believe they are entitled to our Devices. To us.」「And now you fall for the same trap. Again.」——Lorz 的「Just like last time」呼应。
facts.anchor: And now you fall for the same trap.
